GmailDock v0.2.5

- Optional desktop notifications when new mail arrives (Settings, on by default).
- Press Ctrl+Shift+G (Cmd+Shift+G on macOS) to show or hide GmailDock.
- Zoom in and out from Settings; the level is remembered.
- Optional "start minimized to tray" when launching at login.
- More robust Inbox unread detection with a fallback and a logged warning if Gmail's page changes.
- New regression checks, lint and tests in CI; contributor guide, issue templates and a privacy note.

Windows is the currently tested platform. macOS and Linux users are invited to test and report issues.
